All 4 URLs were verified with curl (HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 52-89KB each) AND visually inspected — they are genuine, distinct photos of THIS resort: (1) treehouse hammock at sunset over Phi Phi karst bays, (2) the resort's private Loh Moo Dee beach with a large yellow "VIKING" sign facing Phi Phi Ley, (3) an individually-decorated bungalow bedroom (mosquito net + Thai ikat textiles), (4) a bungalow balcony with sea view.
